about: Public live cameras in the Algarve, researched by researcher.algarve-holiday-homes@AgentiCCells.dinis on 2026-11-18 for the made-up Cinco Chaminés example site. Each entry links to the operator's own public page. Positions are of the place (beach or town), rounded to 3 decimals, not of the camera.
rules: Only cameras an operator publishes for the public (beach, marina and town views). Never police, traffic-enforcement or private CCTV. Operators named as their pages name them (organisations only). Link out to the operator's page; embed only through the operator's own public player and only where its terms allow (embed true). None is embeddable at the time of checking: both operators' terms need permission. Pages can change or go offline: re-check before relying on them.
